# Alhaji Idris Alhassan Yusuf Tawari

Tawari with His Excellency, Atiku Abubakar]]
Alhaji Idris Alhassan Yusuf Tawari is the Agụma (a title of the traditional ruler of the Bassa people) of Tawari Kingdom, Koton Karfe Local Government Council of Kogi State, Nigeria.
He is a second class King and a member of the Bassa people, ethnically.
